questionText: Listen to a conversation at a bike hire shop where a tourist rents a bicycle for a day trip.
audioScript:
Situation: A tourist visits a bike hire shop to rent a bicycle for a day trip along the coast to a lighthouse.
Staff: Good morning, Coastal Cycles, how can I help you?
Customer: Hi, I'd like to rent a bike for the day. What do you have available?
Staff: We have three types: a standard city bike at twelve pounds a day, a hybrid bike at eighteen pounds, and an electric bike at twenty-five pounds.
Customer: I'll go with the hybrid. I'm planning to ride to the lighthouse and back.
Staff: Good choice. That's about twenty miles round trip, so the hybrid's gears will help on the hills.
Customer: Great. Do I need to leave a deposit?
Staff: Yes, we require a fifty-pound deposit per bike, refundable when you return it undamaged. I'll also need photo ID.
Customer: I've got my driving licence. Does the price include a helmet and a lock?
Staff: A lock is included free of charge, but helmets are an extra two pounds. We strongly recommend wearing one.
Customer: I'll take a helmet too. What time do you close?
Staff: We close at six p.m. sharp. Bikes returned after six incur a late fee of five pounds per hour.
Customer: No problem, I'll be back by four. Oh, and is there a basket I can attach?
Staff: Yes, we can fit a rear pannier rack with a bag for an additional three pounds.
Customer: Perfect. I'll take the hybrid, a helmet, and the pannier bag.

questionText: Listen to a phone call to a ferry company booking a crossing for a car and two passengers.
audioScript:
Situation: A traveller phones a ferry company to book a crossing from Dover to Calais for two adults and a car.
Agent: Good afternoon, Channel Ferries, this is Rachel speaking. How may I help?
Caller: Hello, I'd like to book a ferry crossing from Dover to Calais for two adults and a car, travelling next Friday.
Agent: Certainly. Our crossings run every two hours from six a.m. to ten p.m. The crossing time is ninety minutes. Which sailing would you prefer?
Caller: I think the ten a.m. sailing would be good.
Agent: The ten a.m. is available. The standard fare is forty-five pounds per adult and thirty pounds for a car. We also have a premium option for an extra twenty pounds, which includes priority boarding and lounge access.
Caller: I'll just take the standard fare, thanks. Can I book a cabin?
Agent: Cabins are only available on overnight sailings, I'm afraid. For a day crossing, you can reserve a reclining seat for seven pounds per person.
Caller: That might be nice. I'll take two reclining seats. What about luggage?
Agent: Each passenger can bring one carry-on bag up to ten kilos and one suitcase up to twenty kilos at no extra charge. Excess baggage is five pounds per kilo.
Caller: Understood, we'll pack light. Can I pay by card over the phone?
Agent: Of course. There's a one-pound-fifty booking fee for phone card payments. Or you can pay online and avoid the fee entirely.
Caller: I'll pay online then. What's the latest I can check in?
Agent: Check-in closes thirty minutes before departure for vehicles and forty-five minutes for foot passengers.
Caller: Good to know. We'll be driving on, so we'll arrive an hour early to be safe.

questionText: Listen to a woman calling a community arts centre to enrol in a beginner's pottery class.
audioScript:
Situation: A woman calls a community arts centre to enrol in a beginner's pottery course and asks about schedule, cost, and what to bring.
Instructor: Hello, Clayworks Arts Centre, this is Karen. How can I help?
Caller: Hi, I saw your advert for pottery classes and I'd like to enrol in the beginner's course.
Instructor: Wonderful. Our beginner's pottery course runs for six weeks, with one two-hour session each Wednesday evening from six to eight.
Caller: That fits my schedule. How much does the course cost?
Instructor: The full course is one hundred and twenty pounds, which includes all materials and firing. If you prefer to pay per session, it's twenty-five pounds each, but you'd need to buy clay separately.
Caller: I'll sign up for the full course. It's better value. When does the next one start?
Instructor: The next intake begins on the fifth of September. There are currently four spots left out of twelve.
Caller: Great, I'd like to reserve one. What should I bring?
Instructor: Just wear old clothes and closed-toe shoes. We provide aprons and all tools. Oh, and tie back long hair for safety near the wheel.
Caller: No problem. Can I bring a friend to the first session to try it out?
Instructor: We offer a free taster session on the first evening for friends of enrolled students, but they need to book in advance as we cap it at six taster places.
Caller: I'll mention it to my friend. Is there parking at the centre?
Instructor: Yes, there's free parking on site after five p.m. Before that, it's pay-and-display at two pounds an hour.

questionText: Listen to a man calling a mobile network provider to sign up for a new monthly phone plan.
audioScript:
Situation: A man calls a mobile network provider to sign up for a new monthly phone plan and asks about data, contract terms, and number transfer.
Agent: Good morning, Connect Mobile, this is James. How can I help?
Customer: Hi, I'd like to sign up for a monthly plan. I'm currently on pay-as-you-go and it's getting expensive.
Agent: I can certainly help. We have three monthly plans. The basic plan is twelve pounds a month and includes five gigabytes of data, unlimited calls and texts.
Customer: That might not be enough data. What's the next one up?
Agent: The standard plan is eighteen pounds a month with fifteen gigabytes of data, and the premium is twenty-five pounds with unlimited data. The premium also includes international roaming in forty countries.
Customer: I travel a lot for work, so the premium sounds best. Is there a contract period?
Agent: All plans are on a twelve-month contract. If you cancel early, there's a termination fee of one month's charge.
Customer: That's reasonable. I'll go with the premium plan. I already have a phone, so I just need the SIM.
Agent: No problem. We offer a SIM-only deal, so no phone cost. There's a five-pound activation fee, but we waive it if you set up a direct debit.
Customer: I'll set up a direct debit then. How long does the SIM take to arrive?
Agent: It takes two to three working days by first-class post. Once you receive it, text the word ACTIVATE to 88555, and your number will be transferred within twenty-four hours.
Customer: Can I keep my existing number?
Agent: Absolutely. You'll need a PAC code from your current provider. Text PAC to 65075 to get it, then give us the code and we handle the rest.
Customer: Perfect. One last thing, is there a data rollover if I don't use it all?
Agent: With the premium plan, data is unlimited so there's no need. But on other plans, unused data rolls over for one month only.

questionText: Listen to a homeowner calling an insurance company to get a quote for combined buildings and contents insurance.
audioScript:
Situation: A homeowner who has just bought a house phones an insurance company to get a quote for combined buildings and contents insurance and asks about add-ons.
Agent: Good afternoon, SecureHome Insurance, this is Oliver. How may I help?
Caller: Hello, I've just bought a three-bedroom semi-detached house and I'd like to get a combined buildings and contents insurance quote.
Agent: Congratulations on the purchase. I'll need some details. What's the rebuild cost of the property? This is different from the market value.
Caller: The surveyor estimated the rebuild cost at two hundred and forty thousand pounds.
Agent: Thank you. And what's the total value of contents you'd like to insure?
Caller: I'd say around thirty-five thousand pounds. That includes about five thousand in valuables like jewellery and watches.
Agent: I see. Our standard combined policy is twenty-eight pounds per month. It covers fire, flood, storm damage, subsidence, and theft. The buildings excess is two hundred and fifty pounds, and the contents excess is one hundred pounds.
Caller: What about accidental damage?
Agent: Accidental damage isn't included in the standard policy, but you can add it for an extra four pounds per month. It covers things like spilling paint on a carpet or putting a foot through a ceiling.
Caller: I think that's worth having. I'm a bit clumsy. What about personal possessions outside the home?
Agent: That's a separate add-on. For an additional three pounds a month, it covers items like laptops and jewellery up to two thousand pounds per item when taken outside the property.
Caller: I'll add that too, since I carry my laptop everywhere. So what's the total monthly premium?
Agent: Let me calculate. The standard is twenty-eight, plus four for accidental damage, plus three for personal possessions, bringing it to thirty-five pounds per month. There's also a ten percent discount if you pay annually instead of monthly.
Caller: That's tempting. How much would the annual payment be?
Agent: The annual total would be three hundred and seventy-eight pounds, compared to four hundred and twenty if paid monthly. That's a saving of forty-two pounds.
Caller: I'll pay annually then. One more thing, I have a burglar alarm fitted. Does that reduce the premium?
Agent: Yes, a NACOSS-approved alarm gives a further five percent discount. I'll need the certificate number.

questionText: Listen to a tenant calling a plumbing company to book an appointment for a leaking water heater.
audioScript:
Situation: A tenant phones a plumbing company to book an appointment for a leaking water heater and discusses fees, invoicing, and access details.
Receptionist: Good morning, A1 Plumbing Services, this is Julie. How can I help?
Caller: Hi, I've got a water heater that's leaking from the bottom and I need someone to come and look at it.
Receptionist: I'm sorry to hear that. Is it an emergency? Is water flowing freely or just dripping?
Caller: It's a steady drip, not gushing, but it's been going since last night and the floor is getting wet.
Receptionist: I see. We can send a plumber tomorrow morning between nine and twelve. Our call-out fee is forty-five pounds, which includes the first half hour of labour. After that, it's thirty pounds per half hour.
Caller: Tomorrow morning works. Do you charge for parts separately?
Receptionist: Yes, parts are charged at cost plus fifteen percent. The plumber will give you a quote before carrying out any work beyond the initial diagnosis.
Caller: That sounds fair. My landlord said he'd cover the cost, so can you send the invoice to him?
Receptionist: We can do that. I'll need the landlord's name and email address for the invoice. You'll also need to sign an authorisation form when the plumber arrives.
Caller: His name is Peter Whitfield, W-H-I-T-F-I-E-L-D. His email is p dot whitfield at businessmail dot co dot uk.
Receptionist: Got it. Is the property a house or a flat?
Caller: It's a ground-floor flat at fourteen Elm Street. The heater is in the airing cupboard in the hallway.
Receptionist: Perfect. The plumber will need access to the water stopcock as well, in case the supply needs to be shut off. Do you know where it is?
Caller: Yes, it's under the kitchen sink. I'll make sure the area is clear.
Receptionist: Excellent. I'll book you in for tomorrow between nine and twelve. You'll get a text message thirty minutes before the plumber arrives.

questionText: Listen to a customer calling a furniture store to arrange delivery and assembly of a sofa and dining table.
audioScript:
Situation: A customer calls a furniture store's delivery department to arrange Saturday delivery, assembly, and old furniture removal for a sofa and dining table.
Agent: Good afternoon, Homewood Furniture, delivery department, this is Marcus. How can I help?
Customer: Hello, I purchased a three-seater sofa and an oak dining table yesterday at your Lakeside branch, and I'd like to arrange delivery.
Agent: Certainly. Could I have your order number, please?
Customer: Yes, it's H-W-seven-four-nine-two.
Agent: Thank you. I can see the order here. The sofa is the Canterbury model in charcoal grey and the table is the solid oak extending table. Are both items in stock?
Customer: That's right. The salesperson said they could be delivered together.
Agent: Yes, both are at our central warehouse. We have three delivery windows: weekday mornings between eight and twelve, weekday afternoons between one and five, and Saturdays between nine and one. Saturday delivery carries a surcharge of fifteen pounds.
Customer: I work during the week, so Saturday would be ideal. Can you do this coming Saturday?
Agent: Let me check. Yes, we have availability this Saturday between nine and one. The standard delivery fee is twenty-nine pounds, plus the fifteen-pound Saturday surcharge, so forty-four pounds total.
Customer: That's fine. Can the delivery team assemble the furniture as well?
Agent: Assembly is available for an additional charge. The sofa assembly is twenty-five pounds and the table assembly is thirty-five pounds, as it requires extending the leaves and fitting the legs.
Customer: I'll have the table assembled, but I can manage the sofa myself. Does delivery include removal of my old sofa?
Agent: We offer a removal service for old furniture at twenty pounds per item. It's only available for items being replaced by a new purchase.
Customer: I'll add that for the old sofa. What happens if the furniture doesn't fit through my doorway?
Agent: Our team carries a door frame measurer and will check before unloading. If it doesn't fit, there's a return-to-store fee of twenty pounds, and we can arrange an alternative date with a smaller team that can disassemble and reassemble on site for an extra sixty pounds.
Customer: The doorways are quite wide, so I think we'll be fine. I live on the second floor. Is there a charge for upstairs delivery?
Agent: For deliveries above the ground floor without a lift, there's a surcharge of ten pounds per floor per item. So for two items on the second floor, that's an additional forty pounds.
Customer: Right, let me add that up. Delivery forty-four, table assembly thirty-five, old sofa removal twenty, upstairs delivery forty. That comes to one hundred and thirty-nine pounds.
Agent: That's correct. I'll need to take payment for the delivery services today. The furniture itself was paid for in store yesterday.

questionText: Listen to a man calling a cookery school to register for an Italian pasta-making workshop.
audioScript:
Situation: A man calls a cookery school to register for an Italian pasta-making workshop and asks about schedule, cost, and what is included.
Instructor: Hello, Taste of Italy Cookery School, this is Maria. How can I help?
Caller: Hi, I'd like to register for an Italian cooking class. I saw your website and I'm interested in the pasta-making workshop.
Instructor: Wonderful. We have a few options. The pasta-making workshop is a single three-hour session on Saturday mornings, costing sixty-five pounds. We also have a four-week Italian basics course at two hundred pounds, and a one-day intensive at one hundred and twenty pounds.
Caller: The single pasta workshop sounds perfect for my schedule. When is the next one?
Instructor: The next available session is the twelfth of October, from ten a.m. to one p.m. There are three spots left.
Caller: I'll take one. What's included in the price?
Instructor: All ingredients, an apron to use during the class, and you take home everything you make. We also email you the recipes afterward.
Caller: That's great. Do I need any prior experience?
Instructor: Not at all. The workshop is designed for complete beginners. Our instructor, Chef Luca, walks you through every step from dough to shaping.
Caller: Sounds fun. Can I bring my own container for the pasta?
Instructor: We provide takeaway containers, but you're welcome to bring your own if you prefer. Some students bring a large Tupperware box.
Caller: I'll bring my own then. What should I wear?
Instructor: Wear comfortable clothes and flat, closed-toe shoes. We provide aprons, but avoid loose sleeves near the hob. Also, please arrive ten minutes early for a brief safety induction.
Caller: Got it. How do I pay?
Instructor: You can pay by card over the phone now to secure your spot, or we can send a payment link by email. Just note that we require full payment at least forty-eight hours before the class, otherwise the spot is released.
